product_description: Aspen Mesh Packet Inspector (Pcapper) captures the HTTP/2 traffic flowing through the service mesh internally before it is converted from plaintext to mTLS. This traffic is encrypted between Pcapper and the packet broker via outer TLS wrapper using keys and certs that identify both ends.
